verificationLimits: Native C# dispatch and frame parity are not recovered from serialized components.
S2 has one Ranged ability and two identical OnAttack payloads at .267/.467. The original event-consumption/release sequence remains unresolved; no first-event shortcut is enabled.
The original S2 trace-target buff on reach and delayed stop splash (.33s/radius1.5) are retained separately, including clearing the trace target and fear only on the direct branch.

Talent1 source listener is delayed .1s; its per-source DoT triggers immediately and then each second, derives from the resident talent and ends on source removal or before Necrosis recovery ends. S2 DoT priority/refresh clocks still require executable controller validation.
Original particles/audio and modules remain unfinished.
